item.title: Astra Microwave Locks March 2027 Deadline for First Uttam Radars
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Astra Microwave has locked in a March 2027 deadline to deliver its first two indigenous Uttam AESA radars for the Tejas Mk1A, injecting critical momentum into India's indigenous combat aviation roadmap.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The ₹1,844 crore production order forms the bedrock of Astra's current consolidated order book, which stands at ₹4,708 crore. [SPLIT] ⚡ The indigenous AESA radar milestone directly addresses long-standing bottlenecks in the Tejas Mk1A manufacturing pipeline. item.title: GE’s F404 Supply Slump Stalls Tejas Mk1A Production Lines
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Supply chain friction hits Atmanirbhar Bharat as GE Aerospace struggles to maintain the promised four-engine monthly delivery rate for the HAL Tejas Mk1A.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The ongoing supply shortfall disrupts HAL's final assembly lines, leaving multiple Tejas Mk1A airframes completed but grounded without propulsion systems. [SPLIT] ⚡ Meeting the government's year-end target of 22 cumulative engines now hinges entirely on an aggressive delivery surge throughout December.
